name: Choice Electronics
old_description: refurbished Sencore models, for use in all areas of the service
about:
Choice Electronics is based in Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Founded in 1994 by Lance and Christin Tople, the company began as a provider of refurbished test equipment for the service industry.

The company specializes in refurbishing used test equipment to a like-new condition, focusing on Sencore models but also handling Tektronix and Hewlett Packard units. It operates a refurbishment process that restores equipment to near-new performance, backed by a six-month warranty. Choice Electronics also offers NIST-traceable calibration standards on most refurbished units and provides repair and calibration services for equipment not originally purchased from them. The company stocks new Sencore LC103 units with a one-year warranty and distributes new B&K products at discounted prices.

Choice Electronics serves the service industry, including technicians and professionals who rely on test equipment for maintenance and repair work. Its customer base spans more than 30 countries, indicating an international reach. The company caters to buyers seeking cost-effective alternatives to new test equipment, offering savings up to 80 percent off new prices.

The company emphasizes the quality of its refurbishment process, claiming that its refurbished Sencore equipment is in better condition than any other used units on the market. It was started to provide professionals with reliable, affordable test equipment without the need to buy new.
